scope: MLB player-prop discovery, price comparison, projection, and breakdown patterns

patternsFound: Strong book, league, market, player-prop, and date filters
The actionable bet and best price are visually elevated
Clicking an opportunity reveals cross-book price comparison
Highest-value props surface before the full board
Player/game search and fast market filters reduce scanning time
Projection, matchup context, edge, and concise narratives support deeper review
Top props are summarized in the matchup view
View More progressively reveals the full prop set
Signals are grouped inside a game-detail context
Fast game, sport, side, and trend filters

adopt: Rank Best Angles and Leans ahead of the complete board
Make player, team, market, and book search a primary module
Provide one-tap market chips for common MLB prop categories
Highlight the best available price and show the remaining ladder on demand
Use compact visual comparisons for model versus market and projection versus line
Use short plain-English reasons on cards and detailed evidence in a drawer
Keep watchlist conditions distinct from recommendations
avoid: Showing every probability and feature on recommendation cards
Treating unverified splits, movement, or consensus as live context
Using decorative charts that are not tied to current model values
Copying another product's branding, terminology, or page composition

oddsphereMapping.commandCenter: Daily Edge shell, slate status, matchup, probable pitchers, provider health, and safety state
oddsphereMapping.featuredProps: Best Angle and Lean cards with best price, edge, EV, confidence, and one reason
oddsphereMapping.discovery: Prominent search plus MLB market chips; results open the same trusted breakdown drawer
oddsphereMapping.visualAnalysis: Model-vs-market bars, projection-vs-line scale, book ladder, confidence meter, and feature checklist built only from current row data
oddsphereMapping.watchlist: Compact unlock conditions without recommendation styling
oddsphereMapping.advancedScanner: Secondary Full Board with filters, sorting, responsive rows, and a Details action
oddsphereMapping.safety: Practice and public-display-off labels remain explicit; unavailable context stays unavailable
